notes.title: Patch Notes 24/03/2024
notes.content:
A quick patch focused mostly on fixing issues when importing E1 saves.

- Mirianna Port contract board should now be accessible.
- You should now be able to complete the Shrinehoppers quest in the Seeker's Guild.
- Added multiple Storm Crystals throughout the map. (Added more than 5 just in case, to make it easier to find the necessary amount)
- Fixed Grand Rejuvenation skill causing the game to crash. (However, RMMV does not like it when I use an all-revive skill in a combo, so I had to change the content of the combo a bit)
- Changed the labyrinth time limit from 30 seconds to 45 seconds in the Memory Realm.
- Fixed few typos. 

Cheers,
Rishi

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4
notes.content:
I guess this one is long overdue, but I have managed to fix most of the remaining bugs that were reported on the forums.

- Jijinbu's sprite will no longer appear in Zoltair.
- The elf in the treehouse should now let you proceed with the quest.
- Immortal Breastplate (Dormant) will be removed when crafting the main item.
- Atop the Lonely Mountain, A Fox's Hammer, and Preparing for Winter quests can now be completed.
- Kenrad can now take help from the person who 'fits the description' for receiving the blessing of Jorvakir.
- Fixed Shrine of Avara 'offer drink' option not working.
- Fixed the teleportation issues inside the Shrine of Avara.
- You can now purchase Crackers from Kanda's Farm.
- Fixed a certain event not triggering in A Distant Graveyard quest, which was making it impossible to complete.

Also, looking at the statistics, I have noticed hundreds of players having clocked multiple hours into the game, but so far there is only one review. If you have played the games for a decent amount of time, please write honest reviews for both games as they help a LOT in the long run. (Including what you liked, didn't like, and what you'd like to see more of in the future)

Considering the size of these projects, it might be a while before Eredia 3 comes out. But based on your feedback and interest, I might release a free DLC expansion for Eredia 2 later this year, which will add another several hours of content. In the meantime, I will keep fixing and polishing things.

Cheers,
Rishi

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3
notes.content:
Thanks to the save files received from players who were stuck in the Unconscious Realm, I was able to recreate the events which seemed problematic for several players. And just for that extra layer of security, I playtested till the end to make sure there were no more unpleasant surprises. The following bugs were squished in this patch.

- The event in the Unconscious Realm should trigger normally.
- The chests containing the Gold and Silver stars should now be accessible inside the tower.
- Players should now be able to enter the elf's treehouse near Mirianna Port.
- Milkor should be available near the camp at his expected location.

Based on my experience over the last two weeks, killing some bugs caused others to spawn. While this should be much more stable than the last few builds, I will closely monitor the forums over the next 24 hours to see if any game-breaking bugs are being reported, and fix them within the same day. But that's the worst case scenario. Since I removed all the end-game self-switches and I completed the playthrough on the affected saves, it is likely that there will be no more critical roadblocks.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2
notes.content:
Another quick hotfix to fix the tiling issues in Nagira's Abode. Also added some fiery shrooms in Miradel mountain.
Regarding the Arredite Mines quest, I wasn't able to reproduce the issue on my end, but I reset the event anyway. Let me know if this works, otherwise I will edit the event in a different way.

notes.title: Fix of the fix 1.1
notes.content: As a temporary solution to get over through the roadblock in the Stromfeld's realm, I have reduced the necessary fight count from 3 to 2 for entering the last room. Players should now be able to proceed to the rightmost room after the two fights after this update.

notes.title: Quick Fix 1.1
notes.content:
While I was playtesting, I noticed that a lot of the reported bugs had already been fixed (like the stromfeld's realm bug), but somehow did not get reflected when uploading through steam. I have reuploaded the files and made a few more fixes, especially for the game-breaking bugs. Since this is a quick-fix, I have not made too many changes to things that do not directly impact the progress in any way (like the missing book in zoltair library), and they will be addressed later.

However, since the upload issue happened before, I will be keeping a close eye on the forums for the next 24 hours. If any of the following issues reappear, please report the them here as comments, and I will work on fixing them ASAP.

The current fixes for game-breaking are:
- Fixed Mirror Palace tiling issues.
- Fixed tiling issues in Stromfeld's realm which possibly caused one fight to not get triggered.
- Fixed Miradel Mountain tiling issues.
- Fixed the twins' dialgoue not ending in Lavinsha Woods.
- Fixed the Arredite Mine cutscene not triggering.

Some minor changes to make the game more balanced:

- Andarath and Lucina fights are now more 'unfair', and you probably won't even be able bring their HPs close to 0. 
- Slightly reduced the defense and healing power of the Manifested Dragon.

Cheers,
Rishi

notes.title: Eredia 2 is LIVE!
notes.content:
I'll keep this short and simple so there's less reading and more gaming. Eredia 2 is now Live and available for purchase at a 30 percent launch discount!

And if you haven't had the chance to play the first game yet, now is the perfect opportunity to buy it at a ridiculous 85% discount, during the launch week of Eredia 2! Although it is not mandatory to do so, the two games are designed to be experienced one after the other. And players who have finished the first game are recommended to export their saves to Eredia 2.

How to export the save file:

-> Navigate to the Eredia: Diary of Heroes/www folder in your steam library.
-> Copy the ENTIRE 'save' folder
-> Navigate to the Eredia: The Great War/www folder in your steam library.
-> Paste the save folder here. 
-> Even though the entire save folder has been exported, you can only load up the file which was saved in the player's home in Miralia after completing the first game. It's necessary to copy the entire folder so that the global and config files do not get missed.
-> When starting Eredia 2 with an imported save, make sure to click 'Continue' instead of 'New Game' and choose the respective file.

Please do remember while playing that this game was made by a single dev, and while I tried to eliminate as many of the bugs as I could find, if you do run into something, please report them in the discussions section. I will try to fix them as soon as I can.

Lastly, please write your honest review after giving the game a try. Your feedback is critical to the success of Eredia as a whole.

That's all. Cheers and happy gaming!
Rishi

Edit - Achievements are broken for now. I tried to fix them before release but nothing worked. I'll try to fix them again over the weekend. If it still doesn't work, I'll remove them completely.

notes.title: Two Days Away!
notes.content:
Dear Potato Lovers,

The testing phase took a bit longer than expected, but I'm glad to announce that almost all of those annoying icky bugs have been squished. At the same time, I have some bad news, some good news, and some even better news.

The good news is that I have managed to enable cloud saves for both Eredia 1 and 2. The bad news is that steam achievements might be broken for Eredia 2. I'm at my wits end trying to get them to work, but it just didn't happen the same way it did for Eredia 1.

As for the better news, we finally have a release date, and it's 14th December 2023. I know it's just two days away, but I couldn't commit to a final release date without knowing that I've eliminated all the bugs, at least the ones that we'd discovered.

My one final advice to players would be to play Eredia 1 first, in case you haven't already. Even though it's not necessary to have an Eredia 1 save file to play the sequel, it's a direct continuation of the story right from where it left off, and it'll be a more enjoyable experience to play these games in order.

That's all! See you on 14th.

Cheers,
Rishi

notes.title: Eredia II Storepage/Progress Report
notes.content:
Dear Eredians,

I am pleased to announce that the main story content for Eredia 2 has finally been completed, and now the focus shifts to tying all loose ends, adding some end-game content, testing stuff, fixing shit, and making sure that the sequel that you have all been waiting for comes out as polished and bug-free as possible.

Because of that, I would like to start the next testing phase ASAP. If you are interested in becoming an early closed-beta tester, please reach out on the discord server.

https://discord.gg/HNUJYsS

Finally, I would like to remind that Eredia 2 is a direct sequel of it's predecessor and the story continues right from where it was left off. While it's not necessary to play Eredia: Diary of Heroes before playing this game, it is HIGHLY recommended that you do so for the best experience.

The tentative release date that we're going for is 1st November, 2023. However, a lot depends on how smoothly the testing goes, and how many bugs we have to squish. Add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss the release announcement.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468490/Eredia_2_The_Great_War/

Cheers!
Rishi
